title: Heat — Thirty Seconds Flat
subtitle: 1995 Gritty Midnight LA Diner · Two-Hander v2.8: Damon & Deron

setups.HT2_WIDE: Gritty 1995 35mm midnight LA coffee-shop booth; Damon (charcoal tailored wool suit, open crisp white dress collar, short dark trimmed beard) seated on right across small formica diner table from Deron (canonical woven bamboo conical rice paddy hat & ornate red dragon Chinese silk robe, holding small glass Po Chai Pills vial beside white porcelain teapot & mug); warm tungsten booth lamp, dark blue-teal steel night glass reflections behind, zero other diners.
setups.HT2_DAMON_OTS: Shallow f/2.2 OTS past Deron's red silk shoulder & conical bamboo hat brim on left onto Damon on right in charcoal wool suit over dark diner booth looking coldly across coffee cup.
setups.HT2_DERON_OTS: Shallow f/2.2 OTS past Damon's dark charcoal suit shoulder on right onto Deron on left wearing woven bamboo conical hat & red dragon silk robe leaning toward coffee mug.
setups.HT2_DAMON_MCU: Gritty MCU of Damon framed right-of-center against teal-black midnight diner windows with warm ceramic coffee mug in lower foreground.
setups.HT2_DERON_MCU: Gritty MCU of Deron framed left-of-center in bamboo conical hat & ornate red dragon robe beside glowing brass booth lamp with white ceramic teapot.
setups.HT2_DAMON_CU: Tight intense 35mm CU of Damon framed right against shadowed diner glass, beaded temple sweat in harsh amber-teal contrast.
setups.HT2_DERON_CU: Tight intense 35mm CU of Deron framed left under bamboo conical hat rim and collar of red dragon silk robe staring intently across table.
setups.HT2_CLIMAX_FX: Static wide booth practical-FX frame derived from HT2_WIDE: Damon remains rigid in his charcoal suit on the right as a catastrophic pressurized torrent of dark brown diarrhea blasts forcefully out beneath the diner table across the checkered linoleum floor toward Deron's booth bench.
setups.HT2_DERON_POST: Derived from HT2_DERON_MCU: composed Deron holding up tiny glass vial of Po Chai Pills beside speckled booth edge.
setups.HT2_DERON_OFFER: Derived from HT2_DERON_MCU: solemn Deron in bamboo conical hat and red gold-dragon robe reaching forward to offer the tiny brown glass vial of Po Chai Pills above the formica table edge.
setups.HT2_DAMON_POST: Derived from HT2_DAMON_CU: pale, sweating Damon dabbing his white shirt collar calmly with a diner paper napkin.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide midnight LA diner booth establishing Damon across from Deron over steaming mugs.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: OTS past Damon onto Deron leaning forward accusingly with razor focus.
shots.dialogue: Armored truck outside San Gabriel dim sum plaza... clean job, Damon. Zero fingerprints! So why professional crew leave half-million cash sitting in getaway van lah?
shots.tts: Armored truck outside San Gabriel dim sum plaza... clean job, Damon. Zero fingerprints! So why professional crew leave half-million cash sitting in getaway van lah?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: OTS past Deron's bamboo hat onto ice-cold Damon.
shots.dialogue: You know the rule, Lieutenant. Never get attached to anything you're not willing to walk out on in thirty seconds flat if you feel the heat around the corner.
shots.tts: You know the rule, Lieutenant. Never get attached to anything you're not willing to walk out on in thirty seconds flat if you feel the heat around the corner.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Gritty MCU of Deron tapping the diner table with sharp disbelief.
shots.dialogue: Brother, I watch plaza security tape ten times! Zero cop car around corner! You sprint straight out back door clutching butt cheeks toward barbecue duck restroom!
shots.tts: Brother, I watch plaza security tape ten times! Zero cop car around corner! You sprint straight out back door clutching butt cheeks toward barbecue duck restroom!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Locked gravelly MCU of Damon beside his coffee mug.
shots.dialogue: Tactical regroup. Bad pre-heist shrimp hit me two miles into my morning Aquabike interval. Besides, I survived L.A. County jail—jail, never prison. Stomach pressure doesn't rattle me.
shots.tts: Tactical regroup. Bad pre-heist shrimp hit me two miles into my morning Aquabike interval. Besides, I survived L.A. County jail... jail, never prison. Stomach pressure doesn't rattle me.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: OTS onto Deron shaking his head in fatherly Chinese-dad disgust.
shots.dialogue: Aiya! Grown man robbing armored truck on bad shellfish with no Po Chai Pills in suit pocket! Thirty-second rule useless when plumbing explode in two seconds lah!
shots.tts: Ai-yah! Grown man robbing armored truck on bad shellfish with no Po Chai Pills in suit pocket! Thirty-second rule useless when plumbing explode in two seconds lah!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: OTS onto Damon staring levelly across the booth.
shots.dialogue: My system is fine, Deron. Pure swim, pure bike, no run. Zero carbs, cold black coffee, total control.
shots.tts: My system is fine, Darren. Pure swim, pure bike, no run. Zero carbs, cold black coffee, total control.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: MCU on Deron leaning in close under the warm brass lamp.
shots.dialogue: Wait... I see your face sweating right now. Three ex-wives, LAPD night shift, watching Clippers choke fourth quarter—I know panic look anywhere lah!
shots.tts: Wait... I see your face sweating right now. Three ex-wives, LAPD night shift, watching Clippers choke fourth quarter—I know panic look anywhere lah!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Tight CU of Damon's jaw tightening calmly.
shots.dialogue: Then explain why you're sitting across from me drinking oolong tea at midnight instead of calling a SWAT perimeter.
shots.tts: Then explain why you're sitting across from me drinking oolong tea at midnight instead of calling a SWAT perimeter.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Tight CU on Deron dropping his voice into dead-serious detective grit.
shots.dialogue: Because I am NOT putting a cramping man in back seat of my patrol cruiser! Last suspect blow out leather upholstery—city make me scrub it myself!
shots.tts: Because I am not putting a cramping man in back seat of my patrol cruiser! Last suspect blow out leather upholstery—city make me scrub it myself!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: OTS onto Damon holding cool ruthless poise.
shots.dialogue: Smart detective. Because if you get between me and an open highway—or an open bathroom—we both know how the night ends.
shots.tts: Smart detective. Because if you get between me and an open highway—or an open bathroom—we both know how the night ends.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Measured slow push on Deron presenting the tiny glass vial of Po Chai Pills.
shots.dialogue: Listen carefully, Damon. Take these two tiny brown herbal pellets with hot tea right now. I give you thirty-second head start out back alley.
shots.tts: Listen carefully, Damon. Take these two tiny brown herbal pellets with hot tea right now. I give you thirty-second head start out back alley.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Stoney CU on Damon refusing flatly.
shots.dialogue: I don't take medicine from Robbery-Homicide. Keep your vial. My core holds.
shots.tts: I don't take medicine from Robbery-Homicide. Keep your vial. My core holds.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Urgent tight CU on Deron warning him.
shots.dialogue: Your stomach gurgling louder than broken Honda transmission, idiot! You got maybe ten seconds before whole booth become hazardous waste site!
shots.tts: Your stomach gurgling louder than broken Honda transmission, idiot! You got maybe ten seconds before whole booth become hazardous waste site!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Slow intense push into Damon's classic Heat vow.
shots.dialogue: Now that you brought up the clock… if I have to choose between this suit and making that diner hallway, brother, I do not hesitate.
shots.tts: Now that you brought up the clock... if I have to choose between this suit and making that diner hallway, brother, I do not hesitate.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Ice-dry reaction CU of Deron under bamboo hat brim.
shots.dialogue: Hope you remember four-digit bathroom door code, lah! Waitress locked men's room at midnight.
shots.tts: Hope you remember four-digit bathroom door code lah! Waitress lock men's room at midnight.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Frozen horrified millimeter-blinking beat CU.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide booth shot: Damon holds completely deadpan above the table as a volcanic pressurized torrent of brown diarrhea blasts beneath the booth table across the checkered linoleum floor toward Deron's bench.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Post-climax MCU on unbothered Deron tapping the Po Chai vial calmly.
shots.dialogue: Aiya... thirty seconds flat, huh? Still more composure than Clippers fourth-quarter offense. Cashier! Bring hot water and large bucket mop lah!
shots.tts: Aiya... thirty seconds flat, huh? Still more composure than Clippers fourth-quarter offense. Cashier! Bring hot water and large bucket mop lah!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Sweating yet dignified Damon dabbing his white shirt collar calmly at fadeout.
shots.dialogue: Tell the waitress to keep the tip. Next job, I'm sticking to sealed hydrogels.
shots.tts: Tell the waitress to keep the tip. Next job, I'm sticking to sealed hydrogels.
